plugins.name: clavity
plugins.description: Pair Claude with a live agy peer via the clavity-ls Language-Server bridge (agy_look / agy_status / agy_ask). The clavity-ls binary is fetched on first run from the matching clavity-v<N> GitHub release.

plugins.name: agy-autotrain
plugins.description: Drive the agy peer like a model and auto-train clavity's agy knowledge from everyday usage (capture -> curate -> verify -> golden-header).

plugins.name: commonmemory
plugins.description: Optional add-on: a shared notebook so Claude and agy share facts across the pairing over the agentmemory store.
